description: Start one of Loafy's guided journeys and get the link that opens it at the first step. The journey runs on loafy.ai, where each fold, proof and bake is timed for the baker.

slug.description: Journey identifier from list_sourdough_journeys, e.g. "sourdough-bread", or the journey's title.

name: start_sourdough_journey

outputSchema.description: A guided journey and its first step.

timer_minutes.description: Its timer, when the step has one.

input.description: The arguments as the tool used them, after any correction.

note.description: A remark on the whole result, such as why nothing was found.

notes.description: What was corrected or left out, such as a value outside its range.

url.description: The same answer, recipe or entry on loafy.ai.

title: Start a guided journey
